title: StyleTTS2, emotive style

tricks: Beta and embedding scale are raised so the emotion follows the text more than the reference clip
Laugh and um are written out as words
Sigh and pause are written as an ellipsis, a sentence break
Backing embedding scale off to 1.5 is the fix if it gets too wild
Speed is ignored; this engine has no speed control

why: StyleTTS2 cloned from the upbeat female clip, with its style knobs pushed toward emotion because it has no tags to lean on.
